'''Hem Dazon''' was a grouchy [[Arcona]] [[scout]] who became stranded on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] after spending all his [[Galactic Credit Standard|money]] on [[juri juice]] and [[salt]]. While on Tatooine, he spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] and was present when [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his companion [[Luke Skywalker]] entered the establishment. The Arcona sat with fellow patrons [[Bom Vimdin]], [[Arleil Schous]], [[Pons Limbic]], and [[Braconnor Bakiska]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hem Dazon frequently spent time in the Mos Eisley cantina after being stranded on Tatooine. He couldn't return to his home planet because he had spent all his credits on salt and juri juice.|An entry in an artist's journal restored and expanded at the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
[[File:HemDazonCL.png|thumb|left|300px|Hem Dazon spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley.]]
Hem Dazon was an [[Arcona]] [[scout]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> who became stranded on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] after spending all his [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on [[juri juice]] and [[salt]], preventing him from returning to his [[homeworld]]. After becoming stranded, he frequently spent [[time]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]].<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1|Hem Dazon's appearance}}</ref> Dazon sat at a table in one of the [[cantina]]'s backrooms<ref name="Complete Locations" /> when the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered the establishment with the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]].<ref name="ANH" />

The Arcona shared the table with four other patrons: the [[Advozse]] [[Bom Vimdin]], the [[Defel]] [[Arleil Schous]], the [[Siniteen]] [[Pons Limbic]], and the [[Stennes Shifter]] [[Braconnor Bakiska]].<ref name="EYNTK" /> Dazon, Bakiska, and Vimdin were still sitting at the table with several other patrons when Kenobi and Skywalker got into a fight with the ruffians [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]] at the cantina's bar.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Dazon was mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Dazon was a grouchy Arcona with [[Color|brown]] skin. He particularly favored the variety of juri juice containing [[Rodian]] [[blood]], even though it made his [[Limb|hands]] tremble and turned his [[eye]]s a putrid golden color.<ref name="EYNTK" /> He spoke in [[Arconese]].<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Hem Dazon wore a brown [[jacket]] in the cantina.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DazonPuppet.png|thumb|right|300px|Hem Dazon was a puppet operated by Liane Liska.]]
Hem Dazon first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> The alien was designed, built,<ref name="CantinaRollCall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> and portrayed<ref name="2015Panel">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog|nolive=1}}</ref> by makeup artist [[Laine Liska]]<ref name="CantinaRollCall" /> during a series of supplemental shots filmed for the cantina sequence on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]]–[[January 25|25]], 1977.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> Liska, creature designer [[Rick Baker]],<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=d1AAd1tsPds|text=Star Wars: A New Hope – Cantina Archeology Part 2: Behind The Scenes of the Mos Eisley Cantina – US|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> and [[Jon Berg]] all drew concept art of the character.<ref name="Auction">{{WebCite|url=https://us.propstoreauction.com/view-auctions/catalog/id/48/lot/12054/index.html#|text=Lot #: 188 Hand-Drawn Flat-top Alien Sketch by Jon Berg Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope|work=[https://propstore.com/ Propstore]|archivedate=20230725225250}}</ref> The character's "costume" consisted only of the head and neck, which was operated as a hand puppet.<ref name="CantinaRollCall" /> It was built over a rough shape made of couch foam with layers of foam and rubber built onto it and plastic forms with beads inside for the eyes.<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref>

No mould was used and so the mask was one-of-a-kind.<ref name="Archeology" /> A silver flashlight in the back of the head made the character's eyes sparkle<ref name="MoviemakingMagic">''[[The Moviemaking Magic of Star Wars: Creatures & Aliens]]''</ref> and is partially visible when Dazon turns his head in the finished film.<ref name="Archeology" /> On set, the character was known as "T Head" due to the shape of the puppet. A [[Lucasfilm]] memorandum dated [[September 13]], [[1978]] stated that the character's name was intended to be "Thadd," although this was never used.<ref name="CantinaRollCall" /> The character instead became known as Hem Dazon, a name first used in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="EYNTK" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[1989]] [[Mos Eisley Cantina Adventure Set|''Mos Eisley Cantina'' Adventure Set]], a miniatures supplement released by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Miniatures">{{SWMB|set=Mos Eisley Cantina Adventure Set}}</ref>
